subject: Request: additional evaluation credits & 2-week POC extension for LogiCore
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@logicore.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, procurement@logicore.ai
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional evaluation credits & 2-week POC extension for LogiCore

Hannah —

Quick ask to move the LogiCore POC forward. We’re at the point where their engineering team needs a larger token budget to finish the integration tests; procurement hit a delay on the PO so they’ve asked for an additional evaluation window and more free credits while they finalize purchase. Key facts: 

- Account: LogiCore (AI-driven logistics optimization)
- Opportunity: potential $420k ARR first year if pilot converts
- Current evaluation: 350k tokens remaining, team expects to need ~850k tokens to complete scenario tests
- Ask: approve an extra 500k token eval credit and a 2-week extension to the POC (no change to pricing yet)
- Linked docs: attached updated SOW and our usage projection from the integration lead

They are enthusiastic and would sign a PO immediately after successful validation; procurement delays are external to our timeline. I recommend we approve a limited extension and credits to keep momentum. If approved, I’ll send an updated SOW and DocuSign link and log the change in HubSpot.

Why this matters: the technical blockers are solved; this is purely runway. Losing momentum here hurts a high-conversion account.

Short ask: Can we get executive sign-off for the 500k token credit + 2-week extension, or a partial approval if you’d rather cap credits?

Thanks —
Ben
--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional evaluation credits & 2-week POC extension for LogiCore

Thanks for the context, Ben. I agree keeping momentum is high priority. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I sign off: 

1) Is the 500k token ask the minimum to complete validation, or a cushion?
2) Do we have a firm verbal commitment from procurement/PO owner on timing to convert after validation?
3) Any precedent approvals for this account in the last 90 days?

If answers are positive I’m comfortable escalating to Laura for final approval; happy to approve a partial package if that lowers risk (e.g., 250k credits + 1-week extension and then reassess).

Ben — can you reply with the quick answers and include any verbal notes from procurement?

Hannah
--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@logicore.ai>, procurement@logicore.ai
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional evaluation credits & 2-week POC extension for LogiCore

Answers below — keeping short: 

1) 500k is near-minimum they requested; their lead engineer said ~400k would be tight and risky. They want 500k to run the end-to-end stress tests.
2) Procurement (procurement@logicore.ai) indicated they expect to finalize the PO within 10 business days after validation; Rachel confirmed verbal commitment to proceed to PO once tests are green.
3) No prior credit exceptions in the last 90 days — this is the first ask beyond standard PLG limits.

Additional context: LogiCore’s evaluation includes a non-production workload that materially increases token usage (longer sequences + reranking runs). The potential ARR and strategic fit justify a lenient approach here, but I recognize the need for guardrails.

If you want to limit exposure, I recommend: 300k token credit + 10-day extension, milestone-based release (additional 200k contingent on passing the stress test in the first week).

Attaching the updated SOW and usage projection.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional evaluation credits & 2-week POC extension for LogiCore

Ben / Hannah —

I reviewed the ask and the commercial upside. Approve the following one-time, conditional exception: 

- Grant 300k tokens of additional evaluation credit now.
- Approve a 10-calendar-day extension to the POC window.
- Hold an automated meter after 7 days: if LogiCore reaches 80% of the additional token allowance and test results are positive, release the remaining 200k tokens.
- Condition: procurement must provide a PO intent email (even a signed LoE) within 10 business days of validation completion; if not received we will terminate the extension and bill consumed tokens at standard trial rates.

Markus, please flag this in billing and set up the temporary token bucket on the account. Ben, Hannah — after Markus confirms the config I’ll request the legal SOW update and ask BizOps to prepare the DocuSign packet.

Laura
--
Laura Bennett
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@logicore.ai>, procurement@logicore.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:56:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional evaluation credits & 2-week POC extension for LogiCore

Rachel / Procurement —

Confirming executive decision and next steps for LogiCore’s POC extension: 

1) What we’re approving now: 300,000 additional evaluation tokens and a 10-calendar-day extension to the POC.
2) Conditional release: we will automatically release an additional 200,000 tokens if LogiCore consumes >= 240,000 of the additional pool and test metrics pass after day 7.
3) Procurement ask: please send an intent-to-purchase note (email is fine) or the PO within 10 business days of completing validation so Legal can finalize the SOW and Billing can convert the account. If no intent/PO is received, the extension will be rescinded and any further usage will be billed per standard trial terms.
4) Attached: updated SOW (LogiCore_MA_PoC_SOW.pdf) and a usage projection. I will send a DocuSign link for the updated SOW once Markus confirms the temporary token bucket is configured.

Thanks for moving quickly here — we’re excited to help you finish validation. Reach out to me or Ben directly if anything changes.

Best,
Hannah
